intro: Zentia makes every meal inviting. With plush cushioning, warm tones, and a sturdy base with optional swivel, it blends timeless dining style with the freedom of movement you choose.

features.title: Soft cushioned seat and backrest ease pressure so you can linger at the table, whether it’s a quick meal or an evening of laughter and stories.
features.text: Curved backrest that supports every posture

features.title: The gentle arc follows your spine, keeping you upright yet relaxed so you can focus on good food and better company without discomfort.
features.text: Diverse leg base options to suit your needs

features.title: The star-shaped base offers stability and the choice of swivel, letting you move fluidly at the table without shifting the chair.
